evidence: SORT SORT-FILE ON ASCENDING KEY ... USING ... GIVING

purpose.domain_detail: Video streaming/rental service ('Vuflix') - module for browsing and purchasing movie titles, and adding to wishlist
purpose.summary: This program is part of a student-built video rental/purchase system called Vuflix. It allows a member to log in by ID, browse movies sorted by various criteria (ID, name, genre, price), and then purchase a title or add it to a wishlist. It checks for duplicate purchases/wishlist entries before writing records.

notable_features: SCREEN SECTION for interactive terminal UI
SORT verb with USING/GIVING for external file sorting
Multiple COPY statements for file SELECT, FD, WS, and SCREEN definitions
Sequential file I-O with NEXT RECORD reads
GOBACK used for program termination and early exit
No EXEC SQL or EXEC CICS
verdict.notes: No IDENTIFICATION DIVISION header present in the snippet (only PROGRAM-ID line), but mechanical indicators confirm it was detected.
